current_uniform_membership.rule: For each class-c anchor i, k_c=min(16,n_c-1) selected positives; uniform Q; denominator selected positives plus all different-class TRAIN.
current_uniform_membership.collapsed_configuration: Set all normalized H_i=u_c within a class. Every selected-positive logit is1/tau, and all different-class logits depend only on class prototypes.
current_uniform_membership.consequence: Context incidence/which classmates are selected disappears. All four context losses have the same value at this configuration (k_c depends on class size, not context). Therefore membership targets do not require unequal within-class geometry. This is not proof this configuration is the actual training outcome or the global optimum.
current_uniform_membership.gradient_limit: For nonzero vectors, derivative of cosine(h_i,h_j) at same normalized direction is zero. Target-dependent same-class cosine gradients vanish even with unequal target weights. Cross-class gradients and CE can remain nonzero; no stationary-point claim for a specific trained checkpoint.

continuous_target.teacher: u_(m,i)=normalized fixed graph signature; define w_(m,ij)=exp(u_(m,i)^T u_(m,j)/tau_T) for different TRAIN nodes with the same class,0 otherwise.
continuous_target.normalization: Q_(m,ij)=w_(m,ij)/sum_(k same class,k!=i) w_(m,ik). W is symmetric within each class; row-normalized Q generally is not symmetric but is reversible with class-row-sum stationary mass.
continuous_target.unconstrained_row_optimum: Outside-log target CE = H(Q_i)+KL(Q_i || p_i). Heterogeneous Q cannot be exactly matched by a uniform within-class conditional p; its unconstrained row optimum asks for unequal pair ratios.
continuous_target.class_conditional_decomposition: Let a_i(j)=exp(s_ij)/sum_(k in same class except i)exp(s_ik), and P_i(class)=sum_class exp(s_ij)/sum_(k!=i)exp(s_ik). Then L_i=-log P_i(class)+H(Q_i)+KL(Q_i || a_i). A class-collapsed geometry makes a_i uniform, adding KL(Q_i||uniform) when Q_i is nonuniform; changing geometry can worsen the class-mass term, so nonuniform Q alone does not prove that collapsed H cannot minimize the full bounded-cosine or mixed-CE objective.
continuous_target.within_class_ratio_condition: A candidate embedding matches all class-conditional teacher ratios iff, for j,k in the same class as i, (G_ij-G_ik)/tau = (K_ij-K_ik)/tau_T. Because full within-class W is symmetric, this becomes G_ij=(tau/tau_T)*K_ij+b_c off-diagonal in each class (n_c>=3); b_c must be shared within that connected class.
continuous_target.elementary_cosine_feasibility: There must exist a symmetric PSD Gram G with diag(G)=1, rank(G)<=d and the required within-class off-diagonal ratios. Cross-class entries must also admit such a global PSD completion. This is an exact algebraic condition for free normalized vectors, not a guarantee that the native graph network can realize them.
continuous_target.sufficient_conditional_teacher_construct: If student tau=tau_T and teacher normalized Gram rank<=d, copying normalized teacher vectors realizes teacher conditional ratios. If tau<tau_T and teacher rank+1<=d, normalized embeddings proportional to [u_i,sqrt(tau_T/tau-1)] realize the ratios; this follows directly from inner products and matches the construction printed for X-CLR in §3.6. Class-mass and downstream CE can conflict with this representation.
continuous_target.hard_label_support_limit: Cross-class Q is0 while finite all-TRAIN softmax probabilities are strictly positive. Thus the full entropic equality is unattainable for this exact hard-support target at finite bounded cosine/temperature; only class-conditional ratio realizability is claimed.
continuous_target.dimension_limit: Raw graph signatures can have rank beyond the native hidden width. No rank/Gram/data inspection was done here, so current realizability is unverified.
continuous_target.stationarity_limit: Even when a noncollapsed free embedding is feasible and gives a lower relevant target term, exactly parallel same-class cosine vectors remain target-Jacobian degenerate. Nonuniform weights do not ensure SGD escapes, competence is protected, or accuracy improves.

prior_collision.MLCL: §§3.1–3.4 assigns different positive sets to private heads sharing one encoder; heads are auxiliary, not served predictive members.
prior_collision.weighted_InfoNCE: §3.1 already defines arbitrary nonnegative weighted pair targets and states symmetric W/S setup.
prior_collision.soft_SupCon: §3.5 changes interclass weights but keeps withinclass weights constant; its inspected ideal geometry still collapses classes. Softening support alone does not supply withinclass differences.
prior_collision.continuous_similarity: §3.6 y-Aware and X-CLR already encode continuous metadata/caption similarities; X-CLR uses exponential cosine weights with a consistent spherical student metric. Class-conditioning fixed graph-signature teacher weights is an attributed adaptation of these primitives, with no novelty clearance.
prior_collision.saved_priors: SBCL/C3GNN/SoftTriple already supply subclasses/multicenter geometry; PerfectlyBalanced already addresses withinclass structure versus class-preserving permutations. None supplies an accuracy guarantee for this native family.

source_notation_limits: Existence statements in the preprint contain exponent/squared-distance notation inconsistencies; use the objective definitions and explicitly derived ratio/Gram identities here, not an unqualified theorem citation.
